stages.name: Unauthenticated RCE in Web and LLM Services
observables: POST requests to /validate endpoint with exec_globals parameter (Langflow)
Modification of FFMPEG Executable Path settings in dizqueTV
Requests to MCP test REST endpoints in LiteLLM proxy
Struts BeanUtils exploitation against N-able N-central

stages.name: Windows AArch64 Payload Fetching
observables: Command-line file transfers via FTP, HTTP, HTTPS, or TFTP on AArch64 Windows systems

stages.name: Linux Local Privilege Escalation
observables: Exploitation of snap-confine TOCTOU race condition (CVE-2026-3888)
Execution as root inside OpenCTI API containers via safeEjs sandbox escape

stages.name: Persistence via PAM and Config Tampering
observables: Upload of malicious .so files into the Linux PAM authentication chain
Path traversal exploitation in Ollama auto-update mechanism (CVE-2026-42249)

stages.name: Security Software Discovery
observables: Automated enumeration of AV/EDR protections on the target system

scenario.summary: This campaign involves the exploitation of unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in LLM-related services and IPTV servers, followed by the delivery of fetch-based payloads to Windows AArch64 systems. Attackers then perform local privilege escalation on Linux systems and establish persistence through configuration tampering or malicious authentication modules.

meta.rationale: Focus on Linux servers running snapd and Windows machines running Ollama. Use the vulnerability scoping step to identify high-priority targets first.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary escalates Linux privileges via snap-confine or DirtyClone and establishes persistence through PAM backdoors or Ollama auto-update tampering.

hunt.name: Local Escalation and Persistence via Metasploit Modules
hunt.description: The adversary uses Metasploit modules to move from a beachhead to full control. This hunt identifies vulnerable systems using vulnerability discovery data and then looks for behavioral signals: the query identifies rare PAM modules loaded into the authentication chain and process activity associated with Linux privilege escalation. An agent weighs the evidence to identify compromised hosts where an attacker transitioned to root or established persistent access.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, affected_package_name, severity_id, title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid IN ('CVE-2026-3888', 'CVE-2026-43503', 'CVE-2026-42249')
config.description: Identify hosts with known vulnerabilities targeted by the new Metasploit modules to focus the behavioral queries.
config.expected_signal: Rows identify hosts running vulnerable versions of snapd, Ollama, or relevant Linux kernels. Silence means no known vulnerable systems were reported.

primitive_config.label: Scope vulnerable hosts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, affected_package_name, severity_id, title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid IN ('CVE-2026-3888', 'CVE-2026-43503', 'CVE-2026-42249')
primitive_config.expected: Rows identify hosts running vulnerable versions of snapd, Ollama, or relevant Linux kernels. Silence means no known vulnerable systems were reported.

config.content: SELECT module_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_module_activity WHERE (LOWER(module_path) LIKE '/lib/security/%.so' OR LOWER(module_path) LIKE '/usr/lib/security/%.so') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY module_path HAVING hosts <= 2 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Find potentially malicious .so files loaded into the Linux authentication chain that indicate a PAM backdoor.
config.expected_signal: A module path seen on only one or two hosts. Genuine PAM modules should be present across the fleet; a backdoor will appear unique to the target.

primitive_config.label: Identify rare PAM modules
primitive_config.content: SELECT module_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_module_activity WHERE (LOWER(module_path) LIKE '/lib/security/%.so' OR LOWER(module_path) LIKE '/usr/lib/security/%.so') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY module_path HAVING hosts <= 2 ORDER BY hosts ASC

nodes.label: Hunt for exploit execution and discovery

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, on_disk, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%snap-confine%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%dirtyclone%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%enum_protections%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%ollama%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Detect the execution of LPE exploits, security software discovery, and Ollama configuration changes.
config.expected_signal: Processes mentioning exploit names or the Metasploit discovery module. Transition of these processes to root or processes with on_disk = 0 are high-confidence indicators.
